faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIM Lucknow Junior Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Junior Manager (Content Writer & Website Coordinator) posts at IIM Lucknow is 30 August 2026. Candidates should submit their applications online before this deadline.

faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Junior Manager (Content Writer & Website Coordinator) position in the IIM Lucknow Recruitment 2026 notification.

faq.answer: The application mode for the IIM Lucknow Junior Manager (Content Writer & Website Coordinator) vacancy is Online. Interested candidates must submit their applications through the official website.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Junior Manager (Content Writer & Website Coordinator) at IIM Lucknow?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Manager (Content Writer & Website Coordinator) position at IIM Lucknow will receive a salary of Rs. 67080 Per Month.

faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Junior Manager (Content Writer & Website Coordinator) post should not exceed 40 years of age. Age relaxation is applicable as per Central Government rules for reserved categories.

faq.answer: Applicants need a Post-graduation degree with at least 60% marks, proficiency in AI design tools like Canva/Adobe Photoshop, and a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience.

faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIM Lucknow Junior Manager (Content Writer & Website Coordinator) Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IIM Lucknow Junior Manager posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Manager (Content Writer & Website Coordinator) position at IIM Lucknow includes a Personal Interview and a Skill Test.
